issues: src/screens/ReceiptFormScreen.tsx uses raw HTML <label> and <select> elements, which violates the "react native components only" rule. Replace them with React Native components (e.g., use the Picker component for the category dropdown on all platforms, and use a Text component for the label) to ensure only React Native components are used.

The UI flow test for the policy acceptance checkbox fails because the checkbox state is not reflected as an ARIA attribute. Although the component uses `accessibilityRole="checkbox"` and `accessibilityState={{ checked }}`, the rendered element lacks the required `aria-checked` attribute, causing the test to think the checkbox never changes. Adjust the implementation to correctly toggle the `aria-checked` attribute (e.g., ensure `accessibilityState` is passed as an object with a `checked` property and verify the component updates it on press).

Static analysis reports delayed navigation caused by a `setTimeout` in the compiled bundle. This originates from navigation being performed after an async delay (e.g., navigation after policy acceptance or after saving a receipt). Modify the code to navigate immediately after the async operation completes, without wrapping it in any timeout. For example, in `src/screens/ReceiptFormScreen.tsx` replace any delayed navigation (if present) with a direct `navigation.navigate('Dashboard')` call, and ensure the policy hook navigates synchronously after checking acceptance.
feedback: The acceptance tests currently pass, but several static validation checks fail, preventing approval. Address the raw HTML usage, ensure the policy checkbox correctly updates its ARIA state for accessibility, and remove any delayed navigation patterns so navigation occurs immediately. Once these issues are fixed and all static checks pass, the app will meet the requirements.
